question: Which article of the Indian constitution is related with Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor?
solution: The correct answer is __**Article 368**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **Article 368** of the **Indian Constitution** deals with the **power of Parliament to amend the Constitution** and the procedure for such amendments. • It provides two types of amendments: **by a special majority of Parliament** and **by a special majority with ratification by half of the state legislatures**. • The article specifies that an amendment to the Constitution does not constitute a law under Article 13, meaning it cannot be invalidated on the grounds of violating fundamental rights. • **Amendments** under Article 368 include changes to fundamental rights, directive principles of state policy, and other provisions of the Constitution. • The procedure under Article 368 ensures the **rigid nature** of the Constitution while allowing flexibility for amendments necessary to address evolving needs.
